messages:
pat: quick sync — support is asking for a 'impersonate user' button in Console to reproduce tenant issues. they're asking for a server-minted impersonation token. comments?
emily: we used to do this as a dev tool; production is trickier. main questions: quota attribution and auditability.
noah: strongly prefer ephemeral tokens with explicit audit_id. router needs to know whether to charge original user/project or the support org.
lee: my worry: if we attribute to original project, teams could hit quota or billing unexpectedly. if we attribute to support, finance will scream.
pat: support's ask: impersonation should count toward the original project's quotas so debugging doesn't sidestep limits. they want an override option for rare emergencies.
emily: security: require justification + 2 approvers for production tenants. store justification text in audit event. no raw keys in browser.
security-bot: policy: impersonation_mint ttl=300s require_approvals=2 record:[actor, approver_ids, justification, ip, device] audit_label=console_impersonation
noah: telemetry: emit impersonation_created, impersonation_revoked, impersonated_request with tags {origin_project, impersonator, audit_id, quota_charged_to}
lee: billing-bot: finance note — if you charge original project there must be an exportable flag "impersonation_debug=true" so we can filter and optionally exclude from invoices.
billing-bot: also recommend a daily digest for orgs with impersonation events > 0 so CSMs can proactively reach out.
pat: router change idea: token contains claim impersonate:project_id and claim quota_policy:{charge_to: original|support|split, split_percent:10}
emily: split charging is appealing but complex. start with two modes: charge_original (default) and charge_support (admin-only). no split for prototype.
noah: implement server-side hard cap: even if charge_support mode used, enforce an absolute emergency ceiling per org to avoid runaway costs.
lee: console UX: modal with justification box, approver selector, radio for "charge to original project" vs "charge to support (admin only)", and checkbox "record audit and notify owners".
security-bot: require approver != requester. SSO+2FA mandatory. revoke endpoint must exist and show active impersonations in console.
billing-bot: add billing tag to audit_id so finance can join logs to billing rows: billing_tag=impersonation_audit_{id}
pat: rollout plan: feature-flag behind internal first, collect telemetry for 2 weeks, then review with security & finance. prototype will only allow charge_original.
emily: decision: prototype with ephemeral tokens, audit hooks, default charge_original, admin opt-in for charge_support later. i'll file the ticket and mock UI.
pat: thanks — please add a short threat model before we enable internal ff.
security-bot: created issue #9012: https://rwd/gh/9012 "console impersonation flow: prototype, quotas & telemetry"
